title: •Combat Readiness
caption: •Combat Readiness (V)
game_text: STARTING: If your starting location was a battleground site, ▼ up to two related locations (one must be a system) with < 4 total {dark-force} and up to three Effects that are always {alter}. Place this Interrupt in Lost Pile.
lore: Imperial troops remain prepared for quick deployment to seize valuable terrain.
copyright: © LUCASFILM LTD. & TM. TM, ® & © 1999 DECIPHER INC.
notes: Unique. Printed base is a Used or Starting Interrupt; slip banner reads STARTING INTERRUPT. ERRATA: the sheet cover notes errata to card #30 on 25 June 2007 (the stub's game_text_note calls the slip text post-errata) — this transcription is what this Remaster sheet prints. The slip's bottom strip prints a small gold/bronze sphere between the caption and the number (errata marker, as #22) — not transcribed as an icon. Inline icons: black box with red-tinted diagonal blade → {dark-force} (stub drops it: 'with < 4 total and'); red circle-slash A mid-sentence ('always {alter}.') → {alter} (stub: 'always Immune to Alter'). Slip prints ▼ where the stub expands it. Margin credits printed vertically: left 'Original concept by Kevin Brownell', right 'Illinois States 2004'. Lore corrected from scan: 'Imperial troops remain prepared' (wiki omits 'remain') — confirmed on the 745 px V0 remake. Base scan only at 350 px; copyright line Endor SE-style form, '1999' legible on the V0 remake. Modern: V0-D-combatreadiness.gif (745 px); VB4 -pre (350) also downloaded.
